briefs.headline: Kansas beats West Virginia 37-14 as Isaiah Marshall runs for 164 and Rodriguez apologizes
briefs.summary: Kansas quarterback Isaiah Marshall rushed for a career-high 164 yards on 19 carries, including a 50-yarder, and completed 15 of 18 passes for 152 yards, Khijohnn Cummings-Coleman and Chase Belcher each scored twice on the ground and the Jayhawks led 30-7 at halftime, West Virginia's biggest halftime deficit of the season, at Milan Puskar Stadium on Saturday afternoon before 45,629; linebacker Trey Lathan, a former Mountaineer, intercepted Michael Hawkins Jr. on the Mountaineers' second play from scrimmage, and Kansas ran for 296 of its 448 yards and held the ball for 36:44, per AP. West Virginia was held to 262 yards, 79 of them in the first half, and Hawkins and Cam Cook combined for 48 rushing yards; Hawkins was 19 of 34 for 227 yards with a 2-yard touchdown run and a 17-yard scoring pass to John Neider, and receiver Jaden Bray was helped off in the fourth quarter. Rich Rodriguez said afterward he apologized to every West Virginia fan, that he did not see it coming and that it was embarrassing; the Mountaineers, with five wins and five losses and two Big 12 wins in seven, need one more win for bowl eligibility and host No. 14 Houston on Saturday, while Kansas, with its first road win of the season, is four wins and six losses.

briefs.headline: App State beats Marshall 20-16 on Hasselbeck's 37-yard run after the Herd led by 10
briefs.summary: Henry Hasselbeck's 37-yard touchdown run on third-and-1 with 12:55 to play capped a seven-play, 71-yard drive and put Appalachian State ahead for good at Joan C. Edwards Stadium on Saturday night before 23,675, after Marshall had led 13-3 on TJ Lester's 2-yard run four plays after Kelvon McBride's strip-sack, recovered by Cole Funderburk, with 10:50 left in the first half; Hasselbeck also scored from a yard out to end a 75-yard, 15-play drive that opened the second half, and freshman Jorge Diaz Nicolas kicked three field goals for Marshall, including a career-long 54-yarder, per AP. Marshall outgained App State 355 yards to 318, held the ball for 34:28 and got 108 yards on 17 carries from Jo'Shon Barbie, but converted one of four fourth downs: Barbie was stopped for no gain on fourth-and-1 with 3:11 to play, six plays after punter Cooper Heimbach's 25-yard fourth-down pass to Sherone White Jr., and a second fourth down failed about two minutes later. Jaquari Lewis ran for 137 yards on 23 carries for App State, which is bowl eligible at six wins and four losses; Marshall has five wins and five losses, two in six in the Sun Belt, has lost two straight and hosts Georgia State on Saturday at 4 p.m. ET.

briefs.headline: USMNT routs Haiti 6-0 in Miami as Pulisic scores twice in Pochettino's second-to-last match
briefs.summary: Auston Trusty scored in the 10th minute from Sebastian Berhalter's cross after a set piece, confirmed by video review, in his first appearance since his father's death last month, and the United States added five goals in the second half of the Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal first leg at Nu Stadium on Saturday, where Haiti was the nominal home side because violence at home has kept it from playing there: Julian Hall in the 52nd on Antonee Robinson's through ball, his fourth goal in five appearances and the one that ties him to the U.S. after prior eligibility for Poland; Christian Pulisic from the penalty spot in the 62nd and from outside the box a minute later on Alex Freeman's assist, in his first match since the World Cup, taking him to 35 goals in 91 appearances and past Eric Wynalda for fourth on the all-time list; Weston McKennie's header off Malik Tillman's corner-kick cross in the 68th; and Folarin Balogun from Tillman's through ball in the 82nd, per ESPN's match report. The U.S. had 71.2% of possession and 10 shots on target to Haiti's two, and Lenny Joseph's 70th-minute finish for Haiti was ruled offside. It was the most goals in a match under Mauricio Pochettino, who said the program has an amazing future; the second leg is Tuesday at 7 p.m. ET at TQL Stadium in Cincinnati, his last match before Manchester United, and the semifinals and final are in March under a coach not yet named.

briefs.headline: Youngstown State beats Marshall 74-71 after the Herd led by 6 at halftime
briefs.summary: Kelvin Amoako had 17 points and 11 rebounds, seven of them offensive, Jeff Nwankwo scored 12 on 5 of 6 shooting and Youngstown State outscored Marshall 46-37 after the break at the Zidian Family Arena at Beeghly Center in Youngstown, Ohio, on Saturday afternoon before 1,463, after the Herd had led 34-28 at halftime; Noah Otshudi scored 28 points on 10 of 21 shooting with four assists and Bryce Slay 21 with three 3-pointers for Marshall, which made 6 of 24 from 3-point range, turned the ball over 17 times and had three players, Khaman Maker, Luke Rasmussen and Erich Harding, reach five fouls, per the ESPN box score and the AP's automated recap. Marshall has one win in four games and hosts East Tennessee State on Tuesday at 7 p.m. ET before visiting North Carolina on Friday.

briefs.headline: Onosato forces out Takayasu for a 7th win and 5 share the Kyushu lead at the halfway mark
briefs.summary: Yokozuna (grand champion) Onosato, chasing a second straight yusho (championship), forced out Takayasu on nakabi (the middle day), day 8 of the Kyushu basho (tournament) at the Fukuoka Kokusai Center on Sunday, and the Japan Sumo Association's tournament leaders page lists five rikishi (wrestlers) at seven wins and one loss: Onosato, ozeki (champion) Kirishima, who forced out fellow ozeki Kotozakura in 2.6 seconds to drop him to a third loss, sekiwake Atamifuji, who pushed out Fujiseiun, and maegashira (rank-and-file) Wakamotoharu and Kinbozan; Asahakuryu and Arashifuji, level with them a day earlier, are off the list, and Nikkan Sports counts four at two losses, among them Takanosho. Ozeki Aonishiki was forced out by sekiwake Fujinokawa for a fourth loss, Kyodo reported, and JSA chairman Hakkaku said of Kirishima, 30, that a wrestler who keeps winning like this begins to see the yokozuna rank, and that the contest starts this tournament if he wants to move up, per Nikkan Sports. The final day is Sunday, Nov. 22.

briefs.headline: Hakunofuji takes a 6th kinboshi off Hoshoryu, who reaches the midpoint at 4 wins and 4 losses
briefs.summary: Yokozuna (grand champion) Hoshoryu, back after sitting out three straight tournaments, was pushed out in the day's final bout on Sunday in Fukuoka by west maegashira (rank-and-file) 3 Hakunofuji, 23, of Isegahama stable, who got both arms inside off the tachiai (initial charge) and kept driving forward each time the yokozuna tried an armlock throw from the right; it was the fourth kinboshi (gold star, a rank-and-filer's win over a yokozuna) Hoshoryu has given up this tournament and the sixth of Hakunofuji's career in nine tournaments since his first, off Onosato in Nagoya last year, tying Daieisho for third among active wrestlers behind Tamawashi and Takayasu, per Nikkan Sports. Hakunofuji, who ended a four-bout losing run and stands at three wins and five losses, said he was happy but wanted to complete his own sumo and climb the rankings. Chief judge Kokonoe, the former ozeki (champion) Chiyotaikai, said Hoshoryu lost the battle for the inside grip at the charge, that what looked like attacking was only resisting, and that he thought the yokozuna should keep competing rather than withdraw.

briefs.headline: Proctor's first triple-double carries a Cavaliers team missing all five starters past the Mavericks
briefs.summary: Tyrese Proctor had 24 points, 11 rebounds and a career-best 10 assists, Cleveland's first triple-double since Max Strus in April 2024, and the Cavaliers won 127 to 117 in Cleveland on Saturday night without Donovan Mitchell, James Harden, Evan Mobley, Jarrett Allen and Peyton Watson, all ruled out after Friday's ground stop stranded the team overnight in South Florida after its loss in Miami, per AP; Mario Hezonja scored 22, rookie Meleek Thomas 20 and Norchad Omier 13 with eight rebounds off the bench. Kyrie Irving scored 20 of his 34 points in the third quarter for Dallas and drew the night's loudest ovation in his return, and Cooper Flagg had 18 points and eight rebounds. Cleveland has seven wins in 14 games and hosts Chicago on Monday.

briefs.headline: Antetokounmpo scores 34 and the Heat block 14 shots in a 20-point rout of the Pistons
briefs.summary: Giannis Antetokounmpo had 34 points, 14 rebounds and eight assists a night after scoring 37 against Cleveland, Klay Thompson made six 3-pointers for 26 points in his return from a sprained ankle and Miami won 137 to 117 at home on Saturday night for a fourth straight win, with nine players recording a block and 14 as a team, one short of the franchise record, per AP; Cade Cunningham scored 33 with eight assists for Detroit. Miami, which opened the season with four losses, became the fourth team in 25 seasons to reach a winning record at the 13-game mark from that start, and Thompson is 26 3-pointers from tying Ray Allen for third on the career list. Detroit visits the Spurs on Tuesday.

briefs.headline: Short-handed Bulls arrive on game day and end the Timberwolves' 5-game winning streak
briefs.summary: Norman Powell scored 23 points and Matas Buzelis had 18 points and nine rebounds for Chicago, which did not reach Minneapolis until Saturday after Friday's ground stop and played without Caleb Wilson, Jalen Smith and Nic Claxton, and the Bulls won 117 to 106 on Saturday, their second win in two nights, per AP; Minnesota missed its first 13 3-point attempts, finished 9 of 38, scored 17 points in the first quarter, its lowest of the season, and failed to reach 110 points for the first time this year. Ayo Dosunmu scored 14 of his 24 in the third quarter against his former team and LaMelo Ball added 19 for the Wolves, who have nine wins in 13 games.

briefs.headline: No. 2 Utah beats No. 22 Arizona 40-39 on Dampier's 70-yard strike after a day-late flight
briefs.summary: Devon Dampier hit Creed Whittemore for a 70-yard touchdown with 2:25 left to answer Noah Fifita's second scoring pass to Isaiah Mizell, and Utah's defense made a fourth-down stop to finish a game in Tucson that kicked off at 8:30 p.m. local time after Friday's FAA ground stop kept the Utes home a day and landed them just after noon Saturday, per AP; Dampier threw for 204 yards and two scores with an interception and a lost fumble and ran for 100 and two more, Daniel Bray ran for 197 and Fifita threw for 356 yards and three touchdowns. Utah, 10-0 and 7-0 in the Big 12, has won 16 straight over two seasons and 12 straight conference games; Arizona is 7-3.

briefs.headline: No. 1 Georgia beats Missouri 48-21 after scoring on its first 5 possessions
briefs.summary: Raylen Wilson returned his first career interception 30 yards to the Missouri 7 on the game's first play and Nate Frazier scored from the 4 two snaps later, 1:01 in, and Georgia led 31-7 at halftime in Athens on Saturday in its first game back at No. 1 in the College Football Playoff rankings, per AP; Frazier ran for three short touchdowns, Gunner Stockton was 18 of 24 for 252 yards with a touchdown pass to Isiah Canion and a rushing score, and the defense held Missouri to 286 yards. Georgia, 9-1 and 6-1 in the SEC, has outscored Florida, Ole Miss and Missouri 117-36 since its home loss to Auburn; Missouri, 6-4, has lost three of four.

briefs.headline: No. 6 Texas beats No. 21 LSU 22-21 on Manning's touchdown pass with 3 seconds left
briefs.summary: Arch Manning found Raleek Brown for a 4-yard touchdown along the left sideline with three seconds left to finish a drive that began at the Texas 42 with 2:19 to play and 21-16 down, converting three third downs along the way, in Tiger Stadium on Saturday night, per AP; Manning was 19 of 35 for 174 yards with three interceptions and also ran for an early score, Sam Leavitt threw for 244 yards and two touchdowns to Jackson Harris for LSU and was intercepted three times, all by Jelani McDonald, and LSU missed a 38-yard field goal at the end of the first half. Texas is 8-2 and 5-2 in the SEC; LSU, 6-4 under first-year coach Lane Kiffin, is all but out of the playoff picture, and Manning, who grew up in New Orleans, follows his grandfather Archie in 1968 and uncle Eli in 2001 with a comeback win in Baton Rouge.

briefs.headline: Oilers beat Maple Leafs 1-0 as McDavid's season-opening points streak reaches 21 games
briefs.summary: Evan Bouchard scored his 12th goal of the season, Connor McDavid assisted to extend his points streak to every one of Edmonton's 21 games and reach 50 points, and Devon Levi made 19 saves for his first NHL shutout in Toronto on Saturday night, Mike Babcock's first game there against the team that fired him in November 2019, per AP; Anthony Stolarz stopped 22 shots in his first consecutive starts of the season with Sergei Bobrovsky struggling since signing July 1. Edmonton is 15-3-3 and 7-1-1 in its last nine; Toronto, 8-12-2, has lost six straight at home in regulation and is 1-8-0 in its last nine.

briefs.headline: Jets beat Blackhawks 5-4 in a shootout after trailing by 4 goals in the 2nd period
briefs.summary: Mark Scheifele had a goal and three assists, passing the late Dale Hawerchuk to become the franchise's points leader with 933 after the original Jets' records were consolidated this season, Kyle Connor reached 700 career points and scored the deciding shootout goal, and Gabriel Vilardi tied it with 1:13 left in regulation in Chicago on Saturday, Winnipeg's sixth straight win and its second comeback from four down this season, per AP; Tyler Bertuzzi, Anton Frondell and Connor Bedard scored in the first period to chase Stuart Skinner, Frank Nazar made it four with 5:16 left in the second, and Nico Daws made 12 saves in relief. Winnipeg is 10-8-3; Chicago, 5-13-2, hosts Toronto on Tuesday, the 100th anniversary of its first game.

briefs.headline: LSU beats No. 14 Gonzaga 81-80 on Dent's 3-pointer with a second left after trailing by 13
briefs.summary: Donovan Dent made a 3-pointer with just over a second left and Davis Fogle missed at the buzzer in Spokane, Wash., on Saturday after Gonzaga had led 68-55 with 7:40 to play; Dent had 23 points and 10 assists, Abdi Bashir Jr. 15 off the bench and Michael Ruzic 12 points and 12 rebounds, also off the bench, for LSU, which also took a halftime lead on a Dent 3 at the buzzer, per AP. Braden Huff had 18 points and 13 rebounds and Fogle 15 points, eight rebounds and six assists for Gonzaga, which missed all seven of its first-half 3-point tries. It was the programs' first meeting; LSU is 4-0 and Gonzaga is 2-1.

waters.reading: 106 cfs, 1.67 feet at 5:15 a.m., which the fetcher reads as rising on both flow and stage against 83.8 cfs and 1.54 feet in its 24-hour comparison.
waters.working: The fetcher's own comparison reads the gauge at Dyer as rising, but Saturday's paper carried 139 cfs and 1.83 feet at the same hour, so against yesterday's printed reading the river is down about a quarter on flow and down a sixth of a foot on stage: the rise that began Thursday has crested and the Williams is dropping back. At 106 cfs it is a comfortable wade and the fetcher still reads it as prime wading water, and falling, clearing water after a bump is the best trout day of the sequence: the fish that were on the seams and the inside edges of the plunge pools while the water was up move back onto the pocket-water lies as it drops, and with Sunday morning's cold the midday hours fish best. A stonefly nymph or a caddis pupa under moderate weight through the heads of the pools and the deeper pockets is the morning pattern, with the long leader and the small fly coming back as the water clears through the day; a sculpin pattern swung tight to the undercut banks still earns the odd larger fish while there is colour left in it.

waters.near: 14 miles above R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.reading: 25.02 feet at 5 a.m., rising against 24.36 in the fetcher's comparison.
waters.read: 25.0 ft and rising — normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Normal pool with ordinary bank access, two tenths of a foot above Saturday's printed reading after a week of slow falling. The wing dams and the riprap are still showing rock and the water is clear enough to fish structure rather than the slack behind it: shad are the forage, so a white or shad-pattern swimbait or a lipless crankbait worked down the face of the wing dams and along the riprap is the pattern, slowed down for water that read a freeze inland overnight, with a jig and crawfish on the slack side of the lock wall for the fish holding off the current. The R.C. Byrd tailwater itself is not gauged; this is the pool side.
waters.source: USGS 03201500 (Ohio River at Point Pleasant); config.SPORTSMAN_WATERS

waters.near: below R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.reading: 26.22 feet at 5 a.m., steady against 26.09 in the fetcher's comparison.
waters.read: 26.2 ft — normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Normal pool and steady, three tenths of a foot above Saturday's printed reading and the steadiest of the three gauges again. Below the dam the pattern is the structure the dam makes: skipjack and shad stack in the current below the gates, and a spoon or a heavy jig worked in the churn, or a live skipjack drifted along the current seams off the lock wall, is the hybrid and catfish setup at this stage; the riprap along the Huntington bank fishes a crawfish-colour jig on the slack side where the bank current breaks. Huntington is the downstream bracket, 30-odd river miles below the dam, not the tailwater reading, which the Corps publish and this pipeline cannot fetch.

waters.reading: Sound at Hampstead: high 11:44 PM (Sat) at 2.9 ft, low 5:41 AM at 0.7 ft, high 12:16 PM at 3.7 ft, low 6:39 PM at 1.0 ft. Surf at Ocean City Beach pier: low 4:23 AM at 1.0 ft, high 11:06 AM at 4.4 ft, low 5:42 PM at 1.1 ft, high 11:34 PM at 3.3 ft. Water 59.4F at Beaufort, 60 miles up the coast, observed 5:36 a.m. Moon waxing crescent, 31% illuminated, 5.5 days old.
waters.read: Fish the moving water either side of high at 11:44 PM (Sat) and 12:16 PM in the sound.
waters.working: Only three sound events land inside Sunday: the cycle's first high was Saturday's 11:44 p.m., tagged above, and the next high after the 6:39 p.m. low falls after midnight Monday, so the day is one flood and one ebb. The sound lags the surf by 78 minutes on the morning low, 70 on the midday high and 57 on the evening low, the shallow sound draining slower than it fills; the table is about 45 minutes later than Saturday's, the morning flood climbs three feet from the 5:41 low to the 12:16 high and the afternoon ebb drops 2.7 feet, and at 31% and five and a half days old the moon is two days short of the first-quarter neap, so the inlet current is easing a little each day. The water at Beaufort read 59.4F at 5:36 a.m., down almost four degrees from Saturday's 63.3F after a night that brought NWS Wilmington's Freeze Warning to inland Pender and a Frost Advisory to coastal Pender, both until 9 a.m., and NWS Newport's Freeze Warning to coastal Onslow; there is no rip current or beach hazards statement for Pender or Onslow in the active alerts list read at 5:47 a.m. No current local report could be read this morning: the Fisherman's Post Topsail and Sneads Ferry feed returned a Cloudflare 403 at 5:47 a.m., and Coastal Angler's newest Topsail report is dated Sept. 1, well past the 21-day gate, so what follows is the reference file's November pattern, not a live report: red drum, speckled trout at their prime, bluefish, spot, sea mullet and blow toads. Tied to today's table and a cold-shocked sound, the morning is slow and the window is the top of the flood and the first of the ebb, roughly 11 a.m. to 2 p.m., when the sun has been on the flats for a few hours: speckled trout in the deeper creek-channel holes and along the ICWW channel edge on a light jig head and a small soft plastic worked slowly, or a live shrimp under a popping cork drifted over the oyster bars at the creek mouths as the water starts to leave the grass. Red drum want the last of the fall, roughly 4 to the 6:39 p.m. low, cut menhaden or a finger mullet on a quarter-ounce head a couple of feet off the creek-channel edges, and the flooded-grass window for a gold spoon is the hour before the 12:16 high. Spot and sea mullet on bloodworm or shrimp on a two-hook bottom rig in the ICWW channel on the last of the flood; bluefish are the beach fish behind the bait pods on a metal jig once the air warms. Flounder are release only.
